title: Infused Crystal Furnace
text: Craft at an Advanced Assembly Table.
Retains twice the vanilla smelting speed. The rear input needs 256 MPU for fuel-free smelting; extra power does not increase speed.

It also accepts fuel; one infused crystal smelts 16 ordinary items. The diamond stays lit under power and drains in steps while burning fuel. Connecting power discards the remaining burn time; disconnecting does not restore it.
